_readme: MASTER CONFIG. Dedicated configs live in subfolders under config/: rendering/ contains POM/PBR/AO/palette/raymarch/materials-proc, lighting/ contains lighting/shadows/fog, geometry/ contains chamfer/corners, gameplay/ contains generator/player, ui/ contains map/debug. Edit those files directly in editor — tree on left shows nested folders. This main.json only holds minimal fallback overrides.
